title: Jamaican Black Bean Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful stew made with black beans, a blend of spices, and a hint of Jamaican flair.
instructions: In a large Dutch oven or oven-safe pot, heat some oil over medium heat.
Add the onion and garlic and sauté until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the allspice, thyme, cumin, and scotch bonnet peppers (if using) and stir for 1 minute.
Add the black beans, coconut milk, and tomatoes. Stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer, then cover the pot and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the stew has thickened slightly and the flavors have melded together.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh cilantro or scallions if desired.
